sentences.text:
Bhairulal vs State Of Rajasthan (2025:Rj-Jd:30088) on 10 July,
2025
Author: Kuldeep Mathur
Bench: Kuldeep Mathur [2025:RJ-JD:30088]
HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT
JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 4444/2025 Bhairulal S/o Narayan Ji, Aged About 39 Years, R/o Rajgarh,
Police Station Parsoli, Tehsil Begu, District Chittorgarh.
(Raj) (At Present Lodged At District Jail Chittorgarh)
----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Jaipal Singh

For Respondent(s) : Mr. Narendra Gehlot, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 10/07/2025 This application for bail under Section 438 BNSS has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.03/2024 registered at Police Station Bhainsroadgarh, District Chittorgarh, for the offences under Sections 420, 467, 468, 406, 120-B and 34 of IPC.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the offences alleged to have been committed by the petitioner are triable by court of Magistrate.

Learned counsel submitted that the petitioner is in judicial custody; challan has already been filed before the competent criminal Court and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time, therefore, the benefit of bail may be granted to the accused-petitioner.
[2025:RJ-JD:30088] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-4444/2025] Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor has vehemently opposed the bail application.

Bhairulal vs State Of Rajasthan (2025:Rj-Jd:30088) on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/155034054/
1
Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Consequently, the bail application under Section 438 BNSS is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-petitioner Bhairulal S/o Narayan Ji arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.03/2024 registered at Police Station Bhainsroadgarh, District Chittorgarh, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for his appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.

(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 238-divya/-
